name: 2,6,10-Trimethyl-2,6,10-triazaundecane
description: 2,6,10-Trimethyl-2,6,10-triazaundecane (CAS 3855-32-1 ) is a tertiary triamine used as a catalyst and curing agent in polymer systems. Its three methylated nitrogen centers make it effective at accelerating cross-linking reactions. In epoxy and polyurethane formulations, this chemical serves as a vital component for performance. In epoxy coatings and adhesives, it functions as a curing accelerator, reducing gel times and improving throughput. Industrial coating lines benefit from its ability to speed up production cycles significantly. Polyurethane formulators use it to control foam rise and gelation balance in rigid and flexible foam systems. In sealant and elastomer production, it supports cross-link density development, contributing to final mechanical performance targets. It also serves as a building block or intermediate in the synthesis of complex amine catalysts. These catalysts are used across specialty polymer applications requiring precise reaction control. The product is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial purity levels suitable for industrial formulation use. Technical grade is the primary market form, with specifications typically defined by amine value and purity by GC.
